_note: 學習路徑內容建置第17批 #3／6：代用詞 one／ones（eng.t_mid.pron.one-ones，會考級／中階）。為了不重複同一個名詞，one 代替『單數可數名詞』（a bigger one）、ones 代替『複數可數名詞』（the big ones）。one/ones 常接在 which、this/that/these/those、形容詞後；不可數名詞不用 one 代替（用 some）。誘答以『單複數不分（one↔ones）／用 it 代替（it 指特定那一個、不接在 a new / 形容詞後）／不可數誤用 a one』鎖唯一正解。刻意避開易被視為冗贅的『those ones』。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix oo_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 one 代替前面提過的單數可數名詞（a bigger one）、用 ones 代替複數可數名詞（the big ones），並知道 one/ones 常接在 which 和形容詞後、不可數名詞不用 one 代替。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'one' replaces a singular countable noun already mentioned, to avoid repeating it: 'I lost my pen, so I bought a new one.'
claims.verification_ref: one 代替已提過的單數可數名詞；a new one；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'ones' replaces a plural countable noun, usually after an adjective: 'I don't want the small plates; I want the big ones.'
claims.verification_ref: ones 代替複數可數名詞、常接形容詞後；the big ones；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'one' means 'any member of a class', while 'it' refers to a specific thing already identified: 'I need a pen — do you have one?' (any pen), not 'do you have it?'
claims.verification_ref: one＝同類中任一個、it＝特定已指明那一個；do you have one（任一支筆）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'one/ones' replaces countable nouns only; an uncountable noun is not replaced by 'a one' (we use 'some'). 'one/ones' is common after 'which'.
claims.verification_ref: one/ones 只代替可數名詞、不可數用 some、常接 which 後；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To avoid repeating the same noun, you can use 'one' in place of a singular countable noun. I don't like this pen; I want that one. Here 'one' = pen.
teach.zh_hint: 為了不重複同一個名詞，可以用 one 代替『單數可數名詞』。I don't like this pen; I want that one.（我不喜歡這支筆，我要那一支。）這裡 one＝pen。

teach.body: This bag is too small. I want a bigger one.
teach.zh_hint: 這個包包太小了，我要大一點的。one＝bag。

teach.body: If you are replacing a plural countable noun, use 'ones', often after an adjective. I don't like the small plates; I want the big ones. (ones = plates.)
teach.zh_hint: 如果代替的是『複數可數名詞』，就用 ones，常接在形容詞後面。I don't like the small plates; I want the big ones.（我不喜歡小盤子，我要大的。ones＝plates。）

teach.body: The red apples are sweeter than the green ones.

'one/ones' often comes after 'which': Which one do you want? Watch two things: (1) 'it' points to a specific, known thing, while 'one' means any member of a group; (2) uncountable nouns are not replaced by 'one' -- use 'some'.
teach.zh_hint: one／ones 常接在 which 後面：Which one do you want?（你要哪一個？）小心兩點：(1) it 是指『特定已知的那一個』、one 是『同類中任一個』；(2) 不可數名詞不用 one 代替，要用 some。

teach.body: Which one is yours, the blue one or the black one?
teach.zh_hint: 哪一個是你的，藍色的還是黑色的？one＝代替單數名詞。

practice.stem: 選正確：I forgot my umbrella, so I bought a new ____.（我忘了帶傘，所以買了把新的）

distractor_rationales.ones: umbrella 是單數，用 one，不用複數 ones。
distractor_rationales.it: 這裡是『一把新的（傘）』、同類中任一把，用 a new one；it 指特定已知的那一把，不接在 a new 後。
distractor_rationales.some: some 用於不可數或複數；『一把（新傘）』是單數可數，用 one。

practice.feedback: 單數可數名詞用 one 代替：a new one。

practice.stem: 選正確：I don't like the small plates. Can I have the big ____?（我不喜歡小盤子，可以給我大的嗎？）

distractor_rationales.one: plates 是複數，『大的（盤子們）』用 ones，不用單數 one。
distractor_rationales.it: it 是單數，不能代替複數的 plates。
distractor_rationales.some: 要承接前面特定的『盤子』，用 the big ones；some 是『一些』，語意不同。

practice.feedback: 複數可數名詞用 ones 代替：the big ones。

practice.stem: 選正確：There are two keys here. Which ____ is yours?（這裡有兩把鑰匙，哪一把是你的？）

distractor_rationales.ones: 問的是『哪一把（單數）』，用 which one，不用複數 ones。
distractor_rationales.it: which 後面代替名詞用 one，不用 it。
distractor_rationales.that: 問『哪一個』用 which one；that 不接在 which 後。

practice.feedback: which 後代替單數名詞用 one：Which one is yours?

practice.answer: I need a pen. Do you have one?
options: I need a pen. Do you have one?
I need some water. Do you have a one?
I need a pen. Do you have ones?
I need a pen. Do you have it?

distractor_rationales.I need some water. Do you have a one?: water 是不可數名詞，不用 a one 代替（要用 some）。
distractor_rationales.I need a pen. Do you have ones?: pen 是單數，用 one，不用複數 ones。
distractor_rationales.I need a pen. Do you have it?: 這裡指『任何一支筆』用 one；it 指特定已知的那一支。

practice.feedback: 同類中任一個可數名詞用 one：Do you have one?

practice.stem: 選正確：My old shoes are worn out. I need to buy some new ____.（我的舊鞋穿壞了，要買些新的）

distractor_rationales.one: shoes 是複數，『新的（鞋子們）』用 ones，不用單數 one。
distractor_rationales.it: it 是單數，不能代替複數的 shoes。
distractor_rationales.them: them 不接在 new 這類形容詞後當被代替的名詞；要用 new ones。

practice.feedback: 形容詞後代替複數名詞用 ones：some new ones。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Which one do you like best?
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Which one（代替單數名詞）有沒有寫對、句尾問號有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。one／ones 不重讀（它只是代替名詞）、重音落在前面的形容詞。

lines.text: This box is too heavy, so I'll take a lighter one.
lines.intonation: 重音在 lighter、a lighter one 句尾下收

lines.text: I like the blue ones better than the red ones.
lines.intonation: 重音在 blue 與 red、句尾下收
